$comment: The media wall beside the road: one entry per era, in order. from and to are written years (to not included). tone is the light on the left (warm) and right (cool) walls. Each media item is a free-licence picture or film hot-linked from Wikimedia Commons, with its author (credit), licence and file page (source). A film plays muted and looped while its era is in sight; start and end (seconds) pick the part that loops. See docs/WALL.md.
